purpose: Offline Home R1 design review. Not a Unity runtime asset or approved implementation.

requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reward chest circular button illustration for a Russian fairy-tale mobile game Home design review.
Input image 1 is the approved gear-button style reference: preserve its round dark navy/sapphire lacquer medallion, substantial antique-gold circular rim, four restrained cardinal gold ornaments, raised carved surfaces and painterly material richness. Input image 2 is ONLY the approved logo's antique-gold filigree and navy material reference; do not copy logo text or crest shape.
Primary request: A complete round medallion button with one large detailed treasure chest centered inside. Chest made of richly carved dark wood with substantial antique-gold corner bands and clasps, restrained sapphire inlays, lid closed, slight three-quarter perspective. The chest must be instantly readable at113 pixels, filling the majority of the inner circular surface. Keep ornament precise but visually restrained, warm top-left highlights and dimensional shaded gold, painterly Russian fairy-tale visual family. The medallion's intentionally opaque dark navy/sapphire inner surface remains solid behind the chest.
Composition: one centered full circular button on a square1024x1024 canvas, with comfortable transparent padding on every side around the exterior gold rim. No part of the circle or its small ornaments clipped.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha outside the entire round button. No checkerboard drawn into pixels. The inside of the button is opaque navy lacquer, not transparent.
Constraints: no letters, text, numbers, extra badge, scenery, coins spilling or flying, glitter, particles, people, other props, logo, watermark. Do not use a flat chest pictogram or generic vector kit; this is a richly textured painterly chest inside the existing round-button family.
